_meta.description: Orion RTM benchmark dataset — 30 curated requirement-test pairs for empirical evaluation.
_meta.source: Synthetic SRS-style requirements paired with realistic pytest test snippets

requirement.title: API Response Time
requirement.description: The REST API must respond to all read requests within 200 milliseconds under normal load (< 100 concurrent users).

test.docstring: Verify that the API responds within the 200ms SLA under standard load.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-101')
def test_api_response_within_200ms(api_client, benchmark):
    """Verify that the API responds within the 200ms SLA under standard load."""
    start = time.time()
    response = api_client.get('/api/v1/items')
    elapsed_ms = (time.time() - start) * 1000
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert elapsed_ms < 200, f'Response took {elapsed_ms:.1f}ms, expected < 200ms'

requirement.title: User Authentication — JWT
requirement.description: The system must authenticate users using JWT tokens. Tokens must expire after 24 hours. Failed authentication must return HTTP 401.

test.docstring: Test that JWT authentication returns 401 on invalid token and token expires after 24 hours.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-102')
def test_jwt_authentication_and_expiry(client, expired_token, valid_token):
    """Test that JWT authentication returns 401 on invalid token."""
    response = client.get('/protected', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {expired_token}'})
    assert response.status_code == 401
    response2 = client.get('/protected', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {valid_token}'})
    assert response2.status_code == 200

requirement.title: Data Persistence — PostgreSQL
requirement.description: All user records must be persisted in PostgreSQL. No data loss must occur on application restart. Records must be retrievable by user_id.

test.docstring: Ensure user records survive application restart and are retrievable by user_id.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-103')
def test_user_record_persists_across_restart(db_session, sample_user):
    """Ensure user records survive application restart and are retrievable by user_id."""
    db_session.add(sample_user)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.expire_all()
    retrieved = db_session.get(User, sample_user.id)
    assert retrieved is not None
    assert retrieved.id == sample_user.id
    assert retrieved.email == sample_user.email

requirement.title: Password Complexity Policy
requirement.description: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long, contain at least one uppercase letter, one digit, and one special character (!@#$%^&*).

test.docstring: Validate password complexity policy: 12 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 digit, 1 special char.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-104')
def test_password_complexity_requirements(password_validator):
    """Validate password complexity: 12 chars, uppercase, digit, special char."""
    assert password_validator.is_valid('Short1!') is False
    assert password_validator.is_valid('nouppercase1!longpass') is False
    assert password_validator.is_valid('NoDigitSpecial!longpass') is False
    assert password_validator.is_valid('ValidPass1!abcde') is True
    assert len('ValidPass1!abcde') >= 12

requirement.title: Rate Limiting
requirement.description: The API must enforce rate limiting of no more than 100 requests per minute per authenticated user. Excess requests must return HTTP 429.

test.docstring: Confirm rate limiter blocks requests exceeding 100/min and returns 429.

requirement.title: File Upload Size Limit
requirement.description: The system must reject file uploads larger than 10 MB. Uploads within the limit must succeed and return HTTP 201.

test.docstring: Verify 10MB file upload limit: rejects oversized files and accepts valid ones.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-106')
def test_file_upload_size_enforcement(api_client, auth_headers):
    """Verify 10MB upload limit is enforced."""
    small_file = create_file_bytes(size_mb=5)
    r1 = api_client.post('/upload', data=small_file, headers=auth_headers)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    big_file = create_file_bytes(size_mb=15)
    r2 = api_client.post('/upload', data=big_file, headers=auth_headers)
    assert r2.status_code == 413

requirement.title: Audit Log Creation
requirement.description: Every write operation (POST, PUT, DELETE) must create an immutable audit log entry containing: user_id, action, resource, and ISO 8601 timestamp.

test.docstring: Ensure audit log entry is created with correct fields on POST/PUT/DELETE.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-107')
def test_audit_log_created_on_write(api_client, db_session, auth_headers):
    """Ensure audit log entry created with user_id, action, resource, timestamp."""
    r = api_client.post('/api/v1/items', json={'name': 'widget'}, headers=auth_headers)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    logs = db_session.query(AuditLog).order_by(AuditLog.created_at.desc()).limit(1).all()
    assert len(logs) == 1
    assert logs[0].user_id is not None
    assert logs[0].action == 'CREATE'
    assert logs[0].resource == 'items'
    assert logs[0].timestamp is not None

requirement.title: Search Result Pagination
requirement.description: All list endpoints must support pagination. Default page size must be 20 items. Maximum page size must not exceed 100 items.

test.docstring: Test that list endpoints paginate with default=20 and enforce max=100.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-108')
def test_pagination_defaults_and_max(api_client):
    """Test list pagination: default page size 20, max 100."""
    r = api_client.get('/api/v1/items')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()['items']) <= 20
    r2 = api_client.get('/api/v1/items', params={'page_size': 50})
    assert len(r2.json()['items']) <= 50
    r3 = api_client.get('/api/v1/items', params={'page_size': 200})
    assert len(r3.json()['items']) <= 100

requirement.title: Cache TTL for Read Endpoints
requirement.description: Frequently accessed read endpoints must cache responses with a TTL of 60 seconds. Subsequent requests within the TTL must return cached data.

test.docstring: Verify that read endpoint serves cached response within 60s TTL window.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-109')
def test_read_endpoint_caching_ttl(api_client, cache_mock):
    """Verify caching TTL is 60 seconds on read endpoints."""
    r1 = api_client.get('/api/v1/catalogue')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    r2 = api_client.get('/api/v1/catalogue')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert cache_mock.get_calls == 2
    assert cache_mock.last_ttl == 60
    assert r1.json() == r2.json()

requirement.title: TLS Enforcement
requirement.description: All HTTP connections must be redirected to HTTPS. The system must reject plaintext HTTP requests with HTTP 301 redirect.

test.docstring: Test that plain HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS with 301.

requirement.title: Email Notification on Failure
requirement.description: The system must send email notifications within 5 minutes when a critical service failure occurs. Notification must include service name, error code, and ISO timestamp.

test.docstring: Check that an email is sent when a service failure is detected.

requirement.title: Database Connection Pool
requirement.description: The database connection pool must maintain a minimum of 5 connections and a maximum of 50 connections. Connections must time out after 30 seconds of inactivity.

test.docstring: Check that the database connection pool is initialized correctly.

requirement.title: Retry on Transient Errors
requirement.description: HTTP client calls must automatically retry up to 3 times on transient errors (5xx, network timeouts). Retry delay must use exponential back-off starting at 1 second.

test.docstring: Verify HTTP client retries on 5xx errors.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-113')
def test_http_client_retries_on_error(http_client_mock):
    """Verify HTTP client retries on server errors."""
    http_client_mock.configure_failures(count=2, status=503)
    result = http_client_mock.get('/api/health')
    assert result.status_code == 200
    assert http_client_mock.call_count == 3

requirement.title: Throughput Requirement
requirement.description: The system must sustain at least 500 transactions per second (TPS) under peak load with no more than 1% error rate.

test.docstring: Check that the system handles 100 concurrent requests without errors.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-114')
def test_system_handles_concurrent_requests(api_client):
    """Verify system handles concurrent requests."""
    import concurrent.futures
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=100) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(api_client.get, '/api/v1/ping') for _ in range(100)]
        results = [f.result() for f in futures]
    assert all(r.status_code == 200 for r in results)

requirement.title: Session Timeout Policy
requirement.description: User sessions must expire after 30 minutes of inactivity. The system must return HTTP 401 on expired session access and clear the session cookie.

test.docstring: Test that sessions do expire after some time.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-115')
def test_session_expires_eventually(api_client, session_token):
    """Test that sessions expire after inactivity."""
    import time
    time.sleep(2)
    response = api_client.get('/api/dashboard', headers={'Cookie': f'session={session_token}'})
    assert response.status_code in (200, 401)

requirement.title: Data Encryption at Rest
requirement.description: All PII fields (email, phone, address) must be encrypted at rest using AES-256. Encrypted values must not be readable in plain text from the database.

test.docstring: Check that user data is stored in the database.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-116')
def test_user_email_field_is_stored(db_session, test_user):
    """Verify user record is persisted."""
    db_session.add(test_user)
    db_session.commit()
    stored = db_session.query(User).filter_by(id=test_user.id).first()

    assert stored.email is not None

requirement.title: Webhook Delivery Guarantee
requirement.description: Webhooks must be delivered at-least-once with a maximum delivery time of 60 seconds. Failed deliveries must be retried up to 5 times with exponential back-off.

test.docstring: Test that webhook payloads are eventually delivered to the endpoint.

requirement.title: CPU Utilization Ceiling
requirement.description: Under normal operating conditions the server CPU utilization must not exceed 70%. Autoscaling must trigger when CPU exceeds 80% for more than 60 seconds.

test.docstring: Check that server CPU does not spike excessively during a load test.

requirement.title: GDPR Data Deletion
requirement.description: On user deletion request, all PII data must be permanently deleted within 72 hours. A deletion receipt must be provided with a unique confirmation ID.

test.docstring: Test that user deletion removes the user record from the database.
test.source_code:
@traces('REQ-119')
def test_user_deletion_removes_record(api_client, db_session, auth_headers, test_user):
    """Verify user record is deleted on DELETE request."""
    r = api_client.delete(f'/api/v1/users/{test_user.id}', headers=auth_headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    result = db_session.query(User).filter_by(id=test_user.id).first()
    assert result is None

requirement.title: Health Check Endpoint
requirement.description: A /health endpoint must respond within 50 milliseconds, return HTTP 200, and include component status for DB, cache, and message queue in a JSON payload.

test.docstring: Verify that the /health endpoint responds with HTTP 200.

requirement.title: Login Attempt Lock-out
requirement.description: After 5 consecutive failed login attempts the account must be locked for 15 minutes. Locked accounts must return HTTP 423.

test.docstring: Test that login with wrong password returns an error.

requirement.title: Vector Search Latency
requirement.description: Semantic vector search over 1 million embeddings must complete in under 100 milliseconds at the 99th percentile. pgvector HNSW index must be used.

test.docstring: Test that a database query completes without raising an exception.

requirement.title: Zero-downtime Deployment
requirement.description: Rolling deployments must achieve zero downtime. During deployment no request must receive HTTP 503. Health checks must pass within 30 seconds of pod startup.

test.docstring: Verify the application can be instantiated without errors.

requirement.title: Multi-factor Authentication
requirement.description: Users must be required to complete MFA (TOTP or SMS) when logging in from a new device or IP address. MFA bypass must return HTTP 403.

test.docstring: Basic test that a user can log in with correct credentials.

requirement.title: Backup and Recovery RTO
requirement.description: Database backups must be taken every 6 hours. Recovery Time Objective (RTO) must not exceed 1 hour. Backups must be stored in a geographically separate region.

test.docstring: Check that a configuration file is present.

requirement.title: Memory Usage Ceiling
requirement.description: The application heap must not exceed 512 MB under normal load. JVM/process GC pause must not exceed 200ms. Memory leaks must trigger alerts via Prometheus.

test.docstring: Test that the core module can be imported.

requirement.title: Input Sanitization — XSS Prevention
requirement.description: All user-supplied text inputs must be sanitized to prevent XSS attacks. HTML tags and JavaScript events must be stripped or escaped before storage.

test.docstring: Test that a POST request with JSON body returns a success response.

requirement.title: CORS Policy
requirement.description: CORS must only allow requests from whitelisted origins. Requests from non-whitelisted origins must be rejected with HTTP 403. The allowed origins list must be configurable via environment variable.

test.docstring: Verify that the API returns a JSON response.

requirement.title: Graceful Shutdown
requirement.description: On SIGTERM, the application must finish processing all in-flight requests within 30 seconds before shutting down. New requests must return HTTP 503 during shutdown.

test.docstring: Check that required environment variables are present.

requirement.title: API Versioning
requirement.description: The API must support versioned endpoints under /api/v{N}/ paths. Deprecated versions must respond with HTTP 410 Gone after the sunset date. Version negotiation must follow semantic versioning.

test.docstring: Verify that the list endpoint returns a list in the response body.
